title: The Old Lady

full_text:
In a clean cottage surrounded by honeysuckle lived an elderly lady who spent her days baking sweet ginger biscuits for neighborhood children and knitting warm stockings for poor sailors.

Her parlor was a haven of peace, where canary birds sang and old grandfather clocks ticked with reassuring calm.

When asked why she always smiled, she replied: "When the heart is filled with love for others, there is no room left for bitterness or loneliness. God's sun shines in the soul that lives for the happiness of its neighbors."
moral: A life spent in selfless generosity leaves an enduring garden of joy in the heart.
